title: Synthetic Dataset for Dependence-Aware Paired-Equivalence Testing
description: A synthetic, fully reproducible balanced spatiotemporal panel (9 buildings, 25 spatial locations, 98 time steps; N=2,450 paired observations) accompanying a manuscript on dependence-aware paired-equivalence (TOST) inference. The dataset reproduces the key structural features exercised by the workflow: paired observations, spatial clustering of locations into buildings, temporal ordering, and a balanced spatiotemporal panel. It contains no proprietary or personal data. The archive includes the frozen dataset, a reproducibility record (generator parameters, seed, and package versions), the generation script, and an executable analysis demo. Author identity and deposit identifiers are withheld for double-blind review.
